study_identification_part.si4_title: Neuroanatomical heterogeneity and homogeneity in individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis

dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.answer: ENIGMA CHR-P multi-site structural MRI dataset
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Single ENIGMA CHR-P dataset pooled across 29 sites including 1579 CHR-P participants and 1243 healthy controls processed with the ENIGMA/FreeSurfer pipeline
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The ENIGMA CHR-P dataset amalgamated clinical and neuroimaging data from 29 sites, comprising 1579 individuals meeting CHR-P criteria ... and 1243 HC participants."

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.answer: HC normative reference and CHR-P clinical target
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HC group used as the normative reference for PBSI z-score estimation and within-group PBSI comparison; CHR-P group used for heterogeneity analyses and to assess deviation from the HC normative profiles
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "the respective neuroanatomical profiles of each CHR-P individual were correlated with the corresponding profiles of the members of the HC group..."

dc3_number_of_healthy_control.detail: Overall: 1243 HC participants; Train: 1243 HC (same pool used as the normative reference, no separate split reported)
dc3_number_of_healthy_control.supporting_text: "comprising 1579 individuals meeting CHR-P criteria ... and 1243 HC participants."

dc4_age_info.answer: Overall mean 22.32 years, sd 4.96; median NR; iqr NR; min NR; max NR. Train mean 22.32 years, sd 4.96; median NR; iqr NR; min NR; max NR
dc4_age_info.detail: Age reported only as mean (SD) for HC; no separate training subset so train assumed same as overall

dc5_sex_info.answer: Overall: male 687 (55.2%), female 556 (44.8%); Train: male 687 (55.2%), female 556 (44.8%)
dc5_sex_info.detail: Counts from HC group; percentages calculated as 687/1243=55.2% and 556/1243=44.8%. No distinct training subset reported so train assumed same as overall
